notes.title: Regarding the Recent Update
notes.content:
We pushed an update to LAMUNATION! yesterday to add a Traditional Chinese translation and fix several bugs. Unfortunately, an error in the update process resulted in some users who downloaded the update having their save data wiped. This issue has now been resolved. We are very sorry for any inconvenience caused.

If you are using the 18+ patch, you will need to redownload the latest version in order for it to be compatible with the update: http://whitepowder.jp/patch/

As always, thank you for your support! LAMUNATION!!!
